input:
EARLIER SCENES (context only):
古代的时候，有一个人叫神农。一天，神农正在路上走，一看很多人正在吃一些植物。一些人一吃植物就生病了，神农想帮别人。所以想知道哪些植物能吃，哪些植物不能吃。
然后，神农开始尝很多植物，比方说他吃过生姜、芥兰和菠菜。一些植物吃真好，特别是黄瓜。但是，一些植物毒得很，特别是夹竹桃。
CURRENT SCENE:
一个人对神农说，麻烦我们可以吃什么植物？神农说，这就要看你想不想生病了。以后，神农告诉别人一些植物能吃，一些植物不能吃。

FLAGGED PLACES:

[P356] 【麻烦】我们可以吃什么植物？神农说
  proposed by the AI checker: [麻烦→请问]我们可以吃什么植物？神农说 (麻烦 cannot directly introduce this question; 请问 is needed.)
  proposed by the correction model: 麻烦[+问]我们可以吃什么植物？神农说
  her past correction (redundant_words): 神农[-开始]找我们可以吃的植物
  her past correction (search_find): 神农开始[-找]我们可以吃的植物
  her past correction (zero_redundant_pronoun): 神农开始找[-我们]可以吃的植物
  rule card redundant_words: Delete words, names, time phrases, or repeated structures when they add no new meaning or repeat information already given. For example, do not add 当 after 是, and do not use two words that express the same time or idea. Not an error: Do not delete a word if it adds a different meaning, such as a different time, person, or detail. Only flag words or structures that repeat information already expressed.
  rule card search_find: 找 means “look for.” Use 找到 when the person successfully finds something. Not an error: Do not use this rule when the meaning is only “look for” and does not include a successful result.

[P357] 这就要【看】你想不想生病了
  proposed by the teacher's pattern/rule: 这就要[看→看到]你想不想生病了 (her pattern: 看 -> 看到 (corrected 37/71 in train))
  her past correction (perception_look_see): 他[看→看到]很多病人 — her note: 看look vs.看到see
  her past correction (non_adjective_degree_patterns): 他看到很多人[很病→生病]了 — her note: “病” is not a normal Adj., so it cannot be with 很 or 不
  her past correction (perception_look_see): 神农[看了→看到了]很多生病的人 — her note: 看look vs.看到see
  rule card perception_look_see: 看 is “look”; 看到 is “see/catch sight of” and shows that the person actually sees something. Use 看到 when the narrative gives the result of seeing. Not an error: Do not flag 看 when the meaning is only “look,” rather than successfully seeing something. 看到 does not always need 了.
  rule card non_adjective_degree_patterns: “病” and “生病” are not normal Adj., so do not use 很 or 不 directly with them. To show degree, use 病得很厉害 or 病得很重.

[P358] 一些【植物】不能吃
  proposed by the correction model: 一些[-植物]不能吃
  her past correction (cause_result_soyi): [因为→这样]大家知道什么植物不能吃 — her note: not “because”
  her past correction (question_patterns): 他们不知道什么植物[-能吃]不能吃
  her past correction (question_patterns): 中国人不知道什么植物[可能还是不可能→能吃，什么植物不能]吃
  rule card question_patterns: Use 是……吗, V不V, or a Wh-question for an indirect question, not 如果. For “wh-ever…, will do that…”, repeat the Wh-word: 哪一筐……就……哪一筐.
  rule card cause_result_soyi: Use 所以 only when the clause before it gives the cause/reason and the clause after it is the result. If there is no cause-result relationship, delete 所以 or use a connector such as 这样, 后来, or 结果 when appropriate. Not an error: Do not flag a causal 所以 when the preceding clause genuinely causes the following result. Use 结果 for an unexpected result, and do not use 所以 for sequence (后来), manner (这样), or purpose (为了…).

places.after: 我们可以吃什么植物？神农说
places.reason: 麻烦 cannot directly introduce this question.
看 means “depend on” here, not visual perception.
The noun is needed and the sentence is grammatical.
